summary: Comprehensive testing of Season-based Leaderboard feature. Backend 100% (14/14 tests passed). Frontend 100% - all 4 leaderboard sections render correctly with podium UI, data matches API response.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/seasons/{id}/leaderboard returns 200
Backend: Response has required fields (top_scorers, top_assists, best_attendance, top_rated, season_name, total_matches, total_training)
Backend: All leaderboard arrays are lists
Backend: Top scorers entries have player info (id, first_name, last_name, jersey_number, team_name, category, position, goals)
Backend: Top scorers sorted by goals descending
Backend: Top assists entries have required fields with assists count
Backend: Top assists sorted by assists descending
Backend: Best attendance has attendance_rate (percentage), sessions_present, sessions_total
Backend: Best attendance sorted by attendance_rate descending
Backend: Top rated has avg_rating rounded to 1 decimal and matches_played
Backend: Top rated sorted by avg_rating descending
Backend: Season context fields (season_name, total_matches=3, total_training=10) present
Backend: Non-existent season leaderboard returns 404
Backend: Leaderboard returns max 20 players per category
Frontend: Season detail page has 4 tabs (Overview | Leaderboard | Matches | Training)
Frontend: Clicking Leaderboard tab shows 4 leaderboard sections
Frontend: Top Scorers section with podium (gold/silver/bronze) and list for 4+ rankings
Frontend: Top Assists section with podium and list
Frontend: Best Attendance section with podium showing attendance_rate as percentage
Frontend: Top Rated section with podium showing avg_rating
Frontend: Podium shows position badges (1, 2, 3) with correct colors
Frontend: Player info includes name, team_name, and stat value on podium
Frontend: Players ranked 4+ displayed in list with rank number, avatar, name, team, jersey number
Frontend: Overview, Matches, Training tabs still work correctly
Frontend: All 4 leaderboard sections have data-testid attributes
Frontend: Leaderboard data matches backend API response values
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (season-tabs, season-tab-leaderboard, leaderboard-goals, etc.)
Leaderboard API correctly aggregates match_player_stats and training_attendance
Sorting is correctly implemented for all 4 categories (descending by stat value)
Frontend LeaderboardSection component is well-structured and reusable across all 4 categories
seed_data_creation: Active season (2025-2026) has 3 completed matches with 33 player stats and 10 training sessions with 75 attendance records (as documented by main agent)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Season Leaderboard feature fully functional. Backend aggregates stats from match_player_stats and training_attendance collections within season date range. Frontend displays 4 sections: Top Scorers (goals), Top Assists (assists), Best Attendance (attendance_rate %), Top Rated (avg_rating). Podium shows top 3 in [2nd, 1st, 3rd] layout with 1st elevated and centered. Translation keys in leaderboard.* namespace are correctly used.

frontend_leaderboard_tab.list_display: Players ranked 4+ shown with rank number, avatar initials/photo, name, team, jersey, stat value
